result.summary: sh scripts/test_parallel.sh (16 partitions) on real Postgres: combined 4449 tests, 6 properties, 5 failures (4450/4455 passed). The known Lua/PlatformTest flake (REQ-161) did NOT recur -- none of the 5 failures match its shape. 4 of the 5 failures are real regressions from this run's diff (commit c1d72550, lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex's new maybe_seed_entity_event_types/2): (1) test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_event_seed_test.exs 'OQ-1... idempotent' expected count==13, got 16 (partition 4); (2) same file 'REQ-140 AC12...' expected count_before==10, got 13 (partition 4) -- both a 3-row overshoot matching the 3 new ENTITY_RECORD_* event types now seeded, against pre-existing hardcoded fixture counts not updated for this change; (3) test/support/tenant_template_test.exs 'template matches an independently migration-built reference schema' fails with TENANT_TEMPLATE_SELF_CHECK_FAILED ... {:event_type_seed_failed, :invalid_schema_name} (partition 11); (4) same file's concurrent-build variant, same error (partition 11). The 5th failure is unrelated pre-existing docs corpus drift: test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_issue_refs_test.exs's T-LIVE-CLEAN test finds docs/issues/ISS-0724.yaml's internal id field (ISS-0722) mismatched with its filename (partition 15) -- not caused by this diff, not the known flake. New test file test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/entity_event_type_seeding_test.exs's 2 tests did not appear among the 5 failures (no evidence they failed), but full per-test pass confirmation isn't printed by mix test for passing tests. Full details in test/reports/report-20260919-WF03-ISS0721-20260919.yaml.
